study.question: Can constant target-matched identity distributions be eliminated at lower measured cost while preserving the native floating-point feature computation, and does constant-statistic arithmetic explain the round20 structural loss?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0020-local_replay AUC 0.6203373141662112, wall 508.0816s, training 415.5287s; g2-r0020-structural_local AUC 0.6200344118940478, wall 522.9641s, training 429.8864s. Structural diagnostics reported identity max error 9.8118434e-8 and same-checkpoint head error 2.2351742e-8 versus the full computation. The smaller implementation was not faster in measured training. Its hard H=0 replacement removes native log(n)-n*log(n)/n cancellation residues in constant groups. Reconstructing that native expression while eliminating constant tables may preserve the useful training trajectory and reduce bucket reduction work. This is an implementation/numerical-sensitivity hypothesis, not evidence that rounding residues are useful information. A 2x2 table-layout by constant-arithmetic design distinguishes these factors. Earlier target_excluded also merges other-field strata, so its AUC 0.6196070277 cannot isolate own-target identity removal.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the complete shallow contextual/static predictor and product-of-marginal hash summaries. Elide only provably constant target-matched tables, retaining their native cancellation formula.

Its analytic constants and smaller tables changed together. Cross both switches and add strict matched/varying feature-equality diagnostics; do not promote mathematical equivalence to training equivalence.

DIN uses target-conditioned learned event activation; this inherited model uses equality partitions, count histograms and nonlearned marginal concentration with a small residual head. Local baseline_reference.py uses normalized softmax and category/brand substitutions, whereas DIN relaxes normalization: it is a field-adapted reference, not an exact reproduction. No novelty claim.

README verifies category/brand/type histories without item identity. No product ID is invented; publisher full paper unavailable in the authorized archive, so detailed DMR mechanism/priority is unverified.

inherited_components: Frozen data construction/split/label visibility/scorer are host-owned; raw tables and sample predictions are unavailable locally and prerequisite audits are inherited, not independently repeated.
18-field static embedding MLP (actual field count read from meta), 4 target-match groups, complete category-brand support, 4x4x4 action-age histogram, log-count fine-recency mixture and action mean.
Both entropy and collision of 256-bin deterministic marginal counts; product coordinates are Hc+Hb and Cc*Cb, not an empirical joint distribution.
28-to-16-to-1 bias-free zero-final-weight residual head and capacity-matched 158-to-64 base MLP at F=18, unchanged allocation order.
No history category/brand embedding execution, custom loss/optimizer, extra labels, input fields, truncation, fitted statistics or source-task supervision.
study.proposed_difference: Two-factor replacement: full four-group tables versus two varying groups per field, crossed with native floating-point cancellation versus analytic constants for field-matched groups. Native sparse H uses clamp(log(max(n,1))-n*log(max(n,1))/max(n,1),0); C uses n^2/max(n,1)^2, with empty support zero. No distribution, conditioning, pairing or output coordinate is intentionally removed. Four standalone modules include source-auditable diagnostics; strict bitwise equality is checked rather than assumed. This is a follow-up implementation study, not a new theoretical architecture or verified priority claim.
predictions: All four cells have equal trainable parameter shapes/order and equal nonidentity base features; support coordinates, masking, empty histories and joint sequence-reversal invariance pass. Hash-bin statistics agree with an independent quadratic oracle within 2e-6 on the host diagnostic batch.

Native sparse versus native full: no changed support/conditioning; require bitwise equality of the 28 identity coordinates on host diagnostics for the strong numerical-fidelity claim. Report matched and varying errors separately. Analytic sparse/full should agree within 2e-6; compare strict equality too.

Before execution, exploratory retention margin is absolute AUC -0.00015 versus full_native; reference scope also requires within -0.00020 of frozen g1-r0012-joint_identity. A single seed can screen but cannot establish equivalence. Both Logloss and seed spread are reported.

Expected twofold reduction in bucket cells per field (1024 to512) is an operation-count prediction only. An efficiency result requires measured >=3% reduction in total training seconds OR end-to-end inference time, without >3% regression in the other, on repeated paired measurements; report wall, throughput, p50/p95 and peak memory too. Same epoch/data-pass cost is primary; no unmeasured equal-compute training claim.

If cancellation sensitivity explains the old result, the arithmetic effects full_analytic-full_native and sparse_analytic-sparse_native should have consistent direction over paired seeds. If full-native exactly replays, sparse-native is bitwise equal and training still diverges, broaden the numerical/execution explanation rather than asserting information loss.
falsifiers: Any changed eligible support, base features, nonempty collision constants, parameter initialization, masking behavior or nonfinite logits invalidates the intended contrast; report execution failure separately from scientific failure.

Varying-group errors beyond tolerance or failure of strict native sparse/full equality falsifies exact numerical fidelity even if AUC improves. Improvement alone cannot establish the claimed implementation mechanism.
No repeated utility retention or no measured speed/memory improvement rejects this efficient implementation, without proving compression impossible.
Absent or inconsistent arithmetic effect across layouts/seeds, or native-full replay drift, weakens the cancellation explanation; do not select an explanation using one favorable seed.
alternative_explanations: Different outer tensor shapes may change GPU reduction kernels even with the same 256-bin reduction length. Native sparse reconstruction is a hypothesis about bitwise fidelity, not a guarantee.
Training amplification of tiny numerical differences or execution nondeterminism; source diagnostics cover only the first 512 validation impressions.
Equal allocated parameters do not imply equal compute; table elimination adds small reconstruction operations.
Original structural loss can arise from a changed training trajectory under tiny feature perturbations rather than a semantically meaningful identity difference.

Single-seed adaptive validation selection across many rounds and user-correlated impressions; no sample predictions or paired user-cluster bootstrap interface is exposed, so no invented intervals/significance.

The current hash summary compresses identity counts and may alias identities. This study fixes hashing and cannot establish raw-identity sufficiency, category-brand binding or transfer of industry results.

Round20 exclusion and pooled exclusion also lost. Same-source replays are reproducibility checks, not independent seeds.
